references.text: The context where Samson finds the jawbone he uses as a weapon
The place was called Ramath-Lehi (the jawbone height) after this event
Shamgar also struck down many Philistines with an unusual weapon - an ox goad
Another incident where Samson killed many Philistines with the Spirit of the Lord upon him
David defeated Goliath with an unconventional weapon, in the same way as Samson
Samson is mentioned among the heroes of faith who by faith performed mighty deeds
